correctness.rationale: For unweighted adjacency D of K_{p,q}, integers p,q>=2, directly derived the commutator off-diagonal block M=a 1_q^T-1_p b^T and ||[D,diag(f)]||=||M||_op. Row-difference bound and rank-one equality witness give sqrt(2/q) within p-part and sqrt(2/p) within q-part. For cross pairs, the explicit rank-two partial isometry gives (sqrt(p-1)+sqrt(q-1))/sqrt(pq); the displayed Y has both exact e1 marginals, and its 2x2 nuclear norm equals this witness by the Frobenius-plus-determinant identity. The inequality is sharp in all p,q including p=q=2. Five fresh floating-point SVD certificate checks corroborate identities; analytic matrix duality proves the full infinite family, not sampling.

value.rationale: Connes distance with an adjacency Dirac operator is not shortest-path distance and is difficult beyond tiny graphs because edges couple in the spectral norm. The first explicit all-size bipartite exact three-type classification with attaining primal-dual nuclear certificates supplies a natural benchmark and quantifies dependence on both shore sizes, rather than a numerical table.
